calibration_driven_revision: The FIRST version of this patch asked get_completeness_check_messages() only about facts 'OMITTED' from the extracted list, returning an additive missed_facts array. Calibration (data/lab/arena/extraction-completeness-verification-v1/calibration.json, first run, cap_scope mechj-calib-) found this version INERT on every one of the 4 list-bearing synthetic cases: an already-merged fact (e.g. 'Favorite movies are Inception, Interstellar, and Tenet') technically contains every item's name, so nothing reads as 'missing' under that wording, even though the extraction obviously bundled 3 distinct items into 1 fact. This is a real design gap caught by calibration BEFORE any paid exploratory spend, not a retry of a failed paid mechanism -- exactly the discipline calibration exists for (mirrors this project's own EVENT_TIME_RESOLUTION_AT_EXTRACTION precedent, but here the calibration caught a fixable prompt-design issue rather than confirming inertness). The prompt and merge logic were revised to explicitly ask for two distinct correction kinds -- MISSING (facts_to_add) and BUNDLED (facts_to_replace: [{original, split_into}]) -- and a second calibration run (cap_scope mechj-calib2-, then a corrected-parsing rerun at mechj-calib3- after a separate bug was found in the calibration SCRIPT's own key-parsing, not the mechanism) confirmed the revised version correctly splits all 4/4 list-bearing cases and leaves the negative control untouched (0 fabrication). Hashes below are for the FINAL, calibration-passed version only.
